system.story: Trained in a megacorp's black special-forces program; disciplined, networked, and expensive to replace - until you went off-book.

description.value:
Origin: Corp-Milspec. You were forged in a megacorp's black special-forces program. You fight as part of a machine, and you make the machine better.

Fire Team Doctrine

When you use the Aid action, or when an ally attacks a target you damaged this round, that ally gains an edge on the attack. The first time each round an ally lands a Tier 1 result as a result of this, you gain 2 Adrenaline (the coordinated-professional loop).

Signature tweak

Your Suppressing Burst also grants one adjacent ally cover while the suppressed area holds.

Bonus skill & contact

You gain the Corporate skill (you know the org that built you) and a Corp-insider contact - a former handler, burned or bought.

Chrome flavor

The cleanest, best-maintained milspec cyberware - reliability-flavored (rerolls, no-glitch). (Benchmark numbers; tuned in the numeric pass.)
